record.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the Indian Monsoon.
      (i) Monsoon is seasonal migration of planetary winds and pressure belts following the sun.
     (ii) The appearance of El Nino leads to stronger trade wind that leads to heavy rainfall in India.
    Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
